decisions.reason: The target preserves all three requirements: Japan Cup and Tenno Sho (Spring) wins, consecutive Tenno Sho (Autumn) wins in the specified state, and defeating Gold Ship at least three times in races; numeric values and newlines are intact.

decisions.proposed_text: Dùng chiến thuật “Late Surger” khi đang có độ yêu thích hạng 1 để giành chiến thắng Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, Oka Sho, Japanese Oaks,\nShuka Sho; vô địch Queen Elizabeth II Cup hai lần liên tiếp,\nSố fan đạt từ 240000 trở lên
decisions.reason: The current text calques the established running style as Chạy giữa and uses the mixed race-name form Oaks Nhật Bản. The revision restores the canonical Late Surger label and player-facing proper race name while preserving all wins, popularity condition, fan threshold, and newline structure.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded locked terms progress.fans and racecourse.hanshin are preserved; project manual-audit policy requires established running styles such as Late Surger and verified Romanized/English race names rather than semantic calques.

decisions.proposed_text: Giành 8 chiến thắng tại các Cuộc đua graded (bao gồm tất cả Cuộc đua G1/G2/G3), trong đó có Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen năm thứ 3,\nTenno Sho (Autumn) năm thứ 3;\nSố fan đạt từ 240000 trở lên.
decisions.reason: The current phrase Cuộc đua trọng thưởng is explicitly forbidden for 重赏 and the Tenno Sho seasonal qualifiers are semantic Vietnamese calques. The revision uses graded, G1/G2/G3, and player-facing race-name forms while preserving the eight-win requirement, third-year qualifiers, fan threshold, and line structure.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community terms race.graded and common.race_grade.g1/g2/g3 require graded and G1/G2/G3; locked terms race.generic and progress.fans require Cuộc đua and Số fan; manual-audit policy keeps race names in verified Romanized/English form.
